scope: Full7-engine/59-card Druid class corpus plus explicit temporaryHP/reserve passages across current class files. Includes previously reviewed components and incidental exclusions. Core rules, feats, spells and semantic omissions still require separate supplements; no whole-system completeness claim.

classRecords.text: Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, does not remove Wounds, and does not restore a dead creature unless a card explicitly says it resurrects. No Cleric feature provides unlimited permanent HP or resource restoration outside encounters. Temporary HP does not stack with itself; use the higher value. Resurrection and corpse-based effects have explicit use limits and cannot generate repeatable corpses, XP, loot or Conviction.

card.name: Divine Rebirth
card.rangeAndTarget: One ally revived by your Cleric feature
card.duration: Instantaneous plus temporary HP for 1 minute
card.effect: Divine Rebirth. Tags: saint, resurrection. When one of your Cleric features returns an ally from death, you may use Divine Rebirth. That ally returns with half its maximum HP instead of the feature's normal returned HP and gains S + M temporary HP for 1 minute. It removes no Wounds and cannot affect a creature that was not actually dead.

source.originalText: Divine Rebirth: On revive, ally returns with 50% HP and a temporary resistance shield.

card.name: Resurrection
card.rangeAndTarget: One allied corpse you touch that died within the previous 1 minute
card.effect: Resurrection. Tags: saint, resurrection, rite. Return the target to life at 1 HP and grant it 2 S + M temporary HP for 1 minute. It gains no removed Wounds and receives no restored expended resources beyond what another rule explicitly provides. A missing vital body prevents the effect. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Resurrection: Return a fallen ally to life with renewed vigor and temporary divine blessing.

classRecords.text: The healing, execution and denial text below deliberately bounds the source's vague percentage/instant-kill claims. HP sacrificed is direct loss, bypasses temporary HP and defenses, cannot be redirected, and cannot reduce the donor below 1. Only a willing ally can donate. HP sacrifice is never damage for class triggers. No class feature here restores the dead or removes Wounds.

card.name: Veinweave: Bloodshield

source.originalText: Veinweave: Bloodshield: Consume 2 Blood Gauge points to create a protective barrier that absorbs damage equal to 20% of your maximum health.

card.name: Bloodbond

When ally takes damage, you may use Reaction to redirect floor(one-quarter of pre-mitigation damage) to yourself; each recipient applies its own defenses once. Once/round when a paid technique heals you, ally gains M temporary HP. No recursive transfers.

source.originalText: Bloodbond: Link with an ally; share 25% incoming damage and transfer 10% healing to them.

card.name: Crimson Pact
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 bleeding enemies and 6 living allies within 30 ft
card.effect: End your Bleeds on chosen enemies; each makes CON save against 4d8 necrotic, half on success. Each chosen ally regains 4d8+M HP and gains 10 temporary HP. Use one shared roll per damage/healing effect; healing does not multiply by enemies or remaining ticks.

source.originalText: Final Cut – Crimson Pact: Detonate all enemy Bleeds to heal nearby allies and grant them barriers. (1/day)

card.name: Momentum Shield

source.originalText: Momentum Shield: Spending Momentum grants temporary HP.

card.duration: Instant; protection until start next turn

source.originalText: Momentum Barrier: Convert your Momentum into a protective shield that absorbs damage for you and nearby allies.

classRecords.text: Wisdom governs spells, form attacks and class DC/M. Hit Die d8; book armor, weapons, saves and skills remain. Retain your own ability scores, HP, saves, proficiency and personality in all forms; form traits replace only the stated anatomy, movement and attacks. No additional monster stat block or separate beast HP pool. One natural attack per Attack Action unless a form explicitly states otherwise, attack PB+WIS, printed dice+WIS damage. Missing natural attack is 1d6 bludgeoning; default walking Speed 30 ft, normal AC, Medium size. Hawk is Tiny, Bear/Earth Warden/hero forms may be Large when space permits. Equipment melds and cannot be used while melded; magical numeric bonuses persist only if compatible with form anatomy and never duplicate armor.

This class follows its explicit book progression instead of the ordinary 25-choice template. Base 1 grants Druidic, spellcasting, all five Base forms and 2 shifts/long rest. Choose one of seven Circles at 2; its level 2 features are a Base-stage exception. Enter the chosen Circle Arch path at 3, gain its 6 feature, then Circle Hero forms at 10 and its 14 feature. Arch Forms unlock 11 despite the historical word Arch; these are forms, not a second promotion. At 11 attune up to 2 Arch forms during long rest. Base forms remain available at higher levels. All features below are automatic at their gate for the chosen Circle; no generic extra class-card choices are added.

Preparation: two cantrips at 1, three at 4, four at 10, plus explicit Circle bonuses. Prepare class level+WIS modifier ranked Druid spells (minimum 1) each long rest, rank limited by Druid spell-rank access, not merely by enough RP. Use approved operational spell entries and Core V 2 RP table/costs in the shared configuration. Book rank-times-two cost and imported spell-slot terminology are preserved as superseded alternatives for this pilot. Circle always-prepared spells do not count toward preparation and use ordinary RP/Dissonance. Rituals must have ritual tag, be prepared and take printed casting time plus 10 minutes; waive base RP only, never consumed materials or other costs. ASI/feat milestones 4/8/12/16/19 belong to general advancement and must not be granted twice.

Shifting: Bonus Action, one long-rest shift use, 10 minutes, early reversion Bonus Action. Reaching 0 HP or incapacitation ends form; excess damage stays on your own HP. Shift uses follow detailed book table:2 at 1, 3 at 4, 4 at 7, 5 at 10, 6 at 13, 7 at 16, 8 at 19. Supplemental runtime alternative 2/3/4/5/6 at 1/4/8/12/16 remains preserved. At 20 changing form is unlimited but does not refill finite form benefits. Speech unavailable in Base forms, available in Arch/Hero. No spellcasting in form until Beast Spells 18 except an explicit form permission. Maintaining an existing spell concentration is allowed, still only one concentration. Changing form spends a use and ends old form features/summons; it does not reset once/rest abilities.

Transformation reserves prevent unlimited replacement HP: at long rest record Buffer Reserve=2 L+M and Form Surge Reserve=PB. A form giving temporary HP draws that many from Buffer Reserve, up to remaining amount, with normal nonstacking; never real healing. A form special described once/transformation also spends 1 Form Surge and cannot be refreshed by resuming the form. Form Surge refills only long rest. Forms cannot grant free casts, RP or shift uses. Auras affect at most 3 enemies and once per enemy per round; retaliation once/round total; ongoing riders refresh, never stack. Entering a legal Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce accumulated Dissonance. Natural attacks do not clear Refrain.

Circle of the Land chooses one terrain at 2. Always-prepared spell pairs at 3/5/7/9 are exactly the source table lines 2662–2669, reproduced in source appendix; their source names resolve to existing approved spell entries before use. They do not bypass rank gates. For this pilot Circle spells are permitted exceptions to ordinary list membership, not newly authored variants. Moon Circle Forms CR table is historical external-stat language: use only these bounded forms, not arbitrary CR beasts. Early Moon benefit is +S damage on first form hit each turn. No imported monster multiattack, spellcasting or legendary actions.

Circle summary: Land preserves lore and recovery; Moon improves shifting; Storm controls lightning and wind; Thorns works poison and roots; Winterfang works cold; Rotshaper uses bounded swarms; Ashen Grove works fire and regrowth. Land/Thorns duplicate Blight Elk and Tanglemaw names are kept as separate source identities. Source auto-failed hostile saves in Master of Decay/Ash become once/turn-2 on one save, not unavoidable control. Stronger supplemental flavor riders are represented explicitly below or retained as unadopted alternatives in source provenance.

card.name: Druidic
card.effect: Know Druidic. Other speakers notice and read your hidden Druidic messages. Nonspeakers notice their presence on WIS Perception DC 15 but need translation magic or learning the language to read them.

source.originalText:
Druidic
You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages. You and others who know this language automatically spot such a message. Others spot the message's presence with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check but can't decipher it without magic.

card.name: Spellcasting
card.effect: Prepare and cast according to the engine. WIS attack/DC; rank gates, components, concentration, Dissonance and RP apply. This entry creates no extra actions or second resource pool.

source.originalText:
Spellcasting
Drawing on the essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the druid spell list.
Cantrips
At 1st level, you know two cantrips of your choice from the druid spell list. You learn additional druid cantrips of your choice at higher levels, as shown in the Cantrips Known column of the Druid table.
Preparing and Casting Spells
The Druid table shows how many Resonance Points you have to cast your druid spells. A spell's base RP cost is twice its Resonance Rank (Rank 0 cantrips cost 0), modified by explicit class features and current Dissonance. You regain expended RP according to the Resonance recovery rules.
You prepare the list of druid spells that are available for you to cast, choosing from the druid spell list. When you do so, choose a number of druid spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level (minimum of one spell). The spells must be of a level for which you have Resonance Points.
For example, if you are a 3rd-level druid, you have 7 Resonance Points. With a Wisdom of 16, your list of prepared spells can include six spells, and they can be of 1st or 2nd level in any combination. If you prepare the Rank 1 spell cure wounds, its base cost is 2 Resonance Points before explicit specialization or Dissonance modifiers. Casting the spell doesn't remove it from your list of prepared spells.
You can change your list of prepared spells when you finish a long rest. Preparing a new list of druid spells requires time spent in prayer and meditation: at least 1 minute per spell level for each spell on your list.
Spellcasting Ability
Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your druid spells, since your magic draws upon your devotion and attunement to nature. You use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Wisdom modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a druid spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.
Spell save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Spell attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Ritual Casting
You can cast a druid spell as a ritual if that spell has the ritual tag and you have the spell prepared.

Spellcasting Focus
You can use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus for your druid spells.

card.name: Shapeshifting
card.effect: Assume an unlocked prepared form or revert early. Apply engine HP, equipment, concentration and reserve rules. This is not a spell and cannot copy monster stat blocks.

source.originalText:
Shapeshifting
At 1st level, you gain the ability to transform into various animal forms. Shapeshifting is Aethel's native druidic transformation discipline and functions according to the following rules:

Activation and Duration
You can use a bonus action to assume a beast form. You can remain in beast form for 10 minutes per use. You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn.

Uses per Day
At 1st level, you can use your Shapeshifting ability twice per long rest. You gain additional uses as you reach higher levels, as shown in the Shapeshifting Uses column of the Druid table.

Available Forms
At 1st level, you can transform into any of the Base Druid Forms listed below. At 11th level, you gain access to Arch Druid Forms. At 10th level, you gain access to Hero Druid Forms specific to your chosen Circle.
Limitations While Transformed
While in beast form:
You cannot cast spells unless specified by your Hero Class
Your ability to speak is limited (only preserved in arch/hero forms)
You retain your mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma)
You gain the physical traits of the chosen form as specified

card.effect: Age one year per ten elapsed years. Does not prevent damage, aging magic, hunger, disease or rest requirements, and grants no retroactive lifespan restoration.

source.originalText:
Timeless Body

card.name: Beast Spells
card.effect: Perform verbal/somatic Druid spell components in any form. Still cannot supply material components from melded gear. At 20 Archdruid waives only noncostly unconsumed components.

source.originalText:

card.name: Archdruid
card.effect: Unlimited legal form changes. Buffer Reserve and Form Surges remain finite; per-rest powers, spell costs and uses never refresh on changing form. Ignore verbal/somatic and noncostly unconsumed material components for Druid spells, including in form.

source.originalText:
Archdruid
At 20th level, you can use your Shapeshifting feature an unlimited number of times.
Additionally, you can ignore the verbal and somatic components of your druid spells, as well as any material components that lack a cost and aren't consumed by a spell. You gain this benefit in both your normal shape and your beast shapes from Shapeshifting.

Druid Circles

card.name: Bonus Cantrip
card.effect: Learn one additional Druid cantrip. Choose one terrain package for Circle Spells at 3/5/7/9; preserve exact source spell pairs and ordinary rank gates.

source.originalText:
Bonus Cantrip
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

card.name: Natural Recovery
card.effect: Restore ceil(Druid level/2)RP, capped by maximum. This is a finite added recovery, not spell slots or multiplied by rank. RP remains fungible; preserved source rank 6 spending restriction is not used in this simplified draft.

source.originalText:
Natural Recovery
Starting at 2nd level, you can regain some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. During a short rest, you choose expended Resonance Points to recover. The Resonance Points can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the points can be used to cast spells of 6th level or higher. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
For example, when you are a 4th-level druid, you can recover up to 2 Resonance Points during a short rest.
Circle Spells
Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid. Choose that land, arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or Murk, and consult the associated list of spells.
Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

card.name: Land's Stride
card.effect: Ignore nonmagical difficult terrain and ordinary plant thorns. Advantage on saves against magically created/manipulated plants impeding movement. Does not bypass walls, fire or nonplant restraint.

source.originalText:
Land's Stride
Starting at 6th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such as those created by the entangle spell.

card.name: Nature's Ward
card.effect: Immune to Charmed/Frightened from fey/elementals, poison damage, Poisoned and disease. Does not suppress all creature abilities or remove an existing curse.

source.originalText:
Nature's Ward
When you reach 10th level, you can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.

card.name: Blight Elk
card.effect: Antlers 2d8+WIS piercing. Enemy starting within 5 ft CON save or 1d4 poison. Wither unattended mundane vegetation within 5 ft cosmetically; tainted water is visibly foul and harmless after 10 minutes. No mass contamination or permanent resource fabrication.

source.originalText:
Blight Elk
Aura of Decay: Enemies that start their turn within 5 ft. of you take 1d4 poison damage
Antlers: Your antler attack deals 2d8 piercing damage
Toxic Presence: Plants wither in your presence, and water becomes tainted

card.rangeAndTarget: Land Hero; bite 5 ft; sense 30 ft
card.effect: Bite 2d6+WIS piercing, STR save or Restrained until end next turn, escape Action against DC. Thorny Body deals 1d4 piercing to one melee attacker after hit; no reflections. Sense ground-contact locations 30 ft on same connected surface, not identities through stone walls.

source.originalText:
Tanglemaw
Bite: Your bite attack deals 2d6 piercing damage and causes the target to be restrained on a failed DC 14 Strength saving throw
Thorny Body: Creatures that touch you or hit you with a melee attack take 1d4 piercing damage
Root Network: You can sense the presence of creatures touching the ground within 30 ft. of you

card.name: Nature's Sanctuary
card.effect: Before roll target WIS save; failure chooses another legal target or attack misses. Success immune to this feature 24 hours. Creature knows requirement; area effects and indirect hazards unaffected.

source.originalText:
Nature's Sanctuary
When you reach 14th level, creatures of the natural world sense your connection to nature and become hesitant to attack you. When a beast or plant creature attacks you, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target, or the attack automatically misses. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours.
The creature is aware of this effect before it makes its attack against you.

card.name: Combat Shapeshifting
card.effect: Restore 1d8 real HP per RP paid, never beyond maximum. Does not restore temporary buffer or shift uses. No Dissonance as class technique; cannot heal after form ended/incapacitated.

source.originalText:
Combat Shapeshifting
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain Combat Shapeshifting. While transformed by Shapeshifting, you can use a bonus action to expend one or more Resonance Points, regaining 1d8 hit points for each RP expended. Activating Shapeshifting itself still spends a Shapeshifting use, not RP.

card.name: Circle Forms
card.effect: Add S damage to first natural-form hit each turn. Bounded replacement for importing higher-CR monsters; all form gates and attunement remain.

source.originalText:
Circle Forms
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Shapeshifting to transform into more powerful beast forms than a typical druid. Your level as a druid determines the maximum CR of the form you can take, as shown in the Druid table.

card.name: Primal Strike
card.effect: Form attacks count as magical against defenses to nonmagical physical attacks. Does not ignore immunity to their actual damage type.

source.originalText:
Primal Strike
Starting at 6th level, your attacks in beast form count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

Beastlord (Alpha Animal Hybrid)

source.originalText:
Mooncursed

Lunar Rage: During a full moon, your attacks deal an additional 1d8 damage
Howl of the Wild: As an action, you can emit a howl that inspires allies or terrifies enemies. Choose one effect: allies within 30 ft. gain 2d8 temporary hit points, or enemies within 30 ft. must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

card.name: Elemental Shapeshifting
card.cost: One shift and one elemental use
card.effect: Choose bounded elemental form: AC 16, natural attack 2d8+WIS chosen element, one/Action. Air flight 60 lightning resistance; Earth burrow 20 through loose soil physical DR 2; Fire fire resistance and melee attacker 1d4 fire once/round; Water swim 60 water breathing cold resistance. Retain own HP/abilities, no external stat blocks.

source.originalText:
Elemental Shapeshifting
At 14th level, you gain the ability to transform into an elemental. You can transform into an air elemental, an earth elemental, a fire elemental, or a water elemental. You can use this feature twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

card.name: Storm Magic
card.effect: Adjust ordinary rain/wind one mild degree; cannot create storms, combat damage, extinguish magical fire or cancel powerful weather spells. Learn thunderwave and fog cloud always prepared, normal costs/rank gates.

source.originalText:
Storm Magic
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain the ability to subtly control the weather around you. If it is raining, you can make it rain harder or stop. If it is windy, you can increase or decrease the wind's intensity. These minor changes last for 1 hour after you stop actively maintaining them.
Additionally, you learn the thunderwave and fog cloud spells, which don't count against your number of druid spells known.

card.name: Thunderous Strike
card.rangeAndTarget: Storm Circle; target Large or smaller damaged by lightning/thunder
card.effect: Target STR save or push 10 ft directly away. No chain through reflected damage, secondary arcs or forced movement; requires your direct spell/form hit.

source.originalText:
Thunderous Strike
At 2nd level, when you deal lightning or thunder damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 feet away from you.

card.name: Storm's Embrace
card.effect: Resistance lightning/thunder. Add WIS modifier to one damage roll against one target of your lightning/thunder spell, once/cast; no multiplication over pulses or area targets.

source.originalText:
Storm's Embrace
Starting at 6th level, you gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage. Additionally, whenever you cast a spell that deals lightning or thunder damage, add your Wisdom modifier to the damage it deals.

card.name: Tempest Raptor

source.originalText:
Tempest Raptor

Flight: You have a flying speed of 60 ft.

card.rangeAndTarget: Storm Hero; antlers 5 ft; teleport 30 ft
card.effect: Antlers 1d8+WIS piercing; after 20 ft approach first hit/turn also 2d8 thunder and CON save or Deafened through end next turn. Step Action teleport 30 ft, departure 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures CON save 2d8 thunder, half success. Sense natural storm approach 24 hours, no exact prediction of magical weather.

source.originalText:
Thunderhorn Stag
Charge: If you move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit with a horn attack, the target takes 2d8 thunder damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of its next turn
Thunder Step: Once per transformation, you can teleport up to 30 ft. in a crack of thunder. Each creature within 10 ft. of the space you left must make a Constitution saving throw or take 2d8 thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn.
Weather Sense: You can sense approaching storms up to 24 hours in advance

card.name: Eye of the Storm
card.effect: Moderate ordinary weather inside sphere, no concentration; does not neutralize spell damage or magical hazards. For lightning/thunder spells choose up to M creatures to succeed initial save and take 0 if normally half; later independent pulses unchanged.

source.originalText:
Eye of the Storm
At 14th level, you gain the ability to create a zone of relative calm within a storm. As an action, you can create a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you. Within the sphere, winds are reduced to gentle breezes, precipitation stops, and temperature becomes moderate. This effect lasts for 10 minutes and doesn't require concentration.
Additionally, when you cast a spell that deals lightning or thunder damage, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one) to automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell, taking no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

card.name: Toxic Affinity
card.effect: Resistance poison and advantage saves against Poisoned. Learn poison spray cantrip in addition to normal limit; use operational catalog effect/cost.

source.originalText:
Toxic Affinity
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against being poisoned. Additionally, you learn the poison spray cantrip if you don't already know it.

card.name: Blighted Touch
card.duration: Instant; Poisoned through end next turn
card.effect: CON save:2d6 poison and Poisoned on failure, half damage/no Poisoned success. Poisoned gives disadvantage attacks/ability checks unless general condition glossary supersedes. Requires normal reach, not automatic touch through barriers.

source.originalText:
Blighted Touch
Starting at 2nd level, you can channel decay through your touch. As an action, you can touch a creature and force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d6 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't poisoned.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

card.name: Withering Aura
card.effect: Up to 3 enemies starting turn in aura CON save or 1d6 poison, once/enemy/round. Mundane plants may wither; no damage to distant terrain or permanent poison stock. Ends on incapacitation.

source.originalText:
Withering Aura
Beginning at 6th level, you emanate an aura of decay. As a bonus action, you can activate this aura, causing nonmagical plants within 10 feet of you to wither and die. Additionally, each creature of your choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 poison damage.
This aura lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it as a bonus action. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

card.name: Blight Elk
card.effect: Antlers 2d8+WIS piercing, +1d4 poison once/turn against Poisoned. Enemies starting 5 ft CON save or 1d4 poison. Ground 10 ft around you is difficult terrain for enemies, no lasting thorns after movement/reversion.

source.originalText:
Blight Elk
Aura of Decay: Enemies that start their turn within 5 ft. of you take 1d4 poison damage
Antlers: Your antler attack deals 2d8 piercing damage
Toxic Presence: Plants wither in your presence, and water becomes tainted

card.name: Tanglemaw
card.rangeAndTarget: Thorns Hero; bite 5 ft; sense 30 ft
card.effect: Bite 2d6+WIS piercing, STR save or Restrained through end next turn, Action escape DC. One melee attacker/round takes 1d4 piercing; one creature restrained by your bite takes 1d4 at start turn. Ground sense 30 ft same surface and advantage against Prone; no wall-penetrating identification.

source.originalText:
Tanglemaw
Bite: Your bite attack deals 2d6 piercing damage and causes the target to be restrained on a failed DC 14 Strength saving throw
Thorny Body: Creatures that touch you or hit you with a melee attack take 1d4 piercing damage
Root Network: You can sense the presence of creatures touching the ground within 30 ft. of you

card.name: Master of Decay
card.effect: Immune poison damage/Poisoned. Before one target rolls initial save against your poison spell impose-2. Replaces source automatic failures; cannot combine multiple identical penalty applications or negate immunity.

source.originalText:
Master of Decay
At 14th level, you gain immunity to poison damage and the poisoned condition. Additionally, when you cast a spell that deals poison damage, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one) to automatically fail their saving throws against the spell.

card.name: Frost Magic
card.effect: Learn ray of frost cantrip and ice knife always prepared, additional to normal counts, ordinary rank gates and costs.

source.originalText:
Frost Magic
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you learn the ray of frost cantrip if you don't already know it. Additionally, you learn the ice knife spell, which doesn't count against your number of druid spells known.

card.name: Cold Resistance
card.effect: Resistance cold and advantage on nonmagical extreme-cold exposure saves. No immunity to suffocation, ice entrapment or magical environmental damage.

source.originalText:
Cold Resistance
Starting at 2nd level, you gain resistance to cold damage. Additionally, you are naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in the environmental rules in Chapter 5.

card.name: Winter's Embrace
card.effect: Up to 3 enemies starting turn inside CON save or 1d6 cold and Speed-10 ft through end turn. Once/enemy/round; success no effect. Does not stack multiple slows or affect flying targets outside sphere.

source.originalText:
Winter's Embrace
Beginning at 6th level, you can surround yourself with an aura of biting cold. As a bonus action, you can activate this aura, causing each creature of your choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
This aura lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it as a bonus action. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

card.name: Snow Leopard
card.effect: Claw 2d6+WIS cold, +1d4 once/turn against slowed foe. +5 Stealth on ice/snow and advantage on legal Hide there; source+10 reduced provisionally. Ignore ordinary ice/snow movement penalties, not magical restraining ice.

source.originalText:
Snow Leopard
Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d6 cold damage
Stealth: You gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in snowy or icy terrain
Frost Walk: You can move across icy surfaces without making ability checks and through snow without penalty

card.name: Frost Wyrmling
card.cost: One shift; breath one short-rest use
card.rangeAndTarget: Winterfang Hero; 30 ft cone up to 3 creatures
card.effect: AC normal+2, cold immunity. Claw 1d8+WIS cold. Breath 4d6 cold DEX half. One breath target may have cold resistance ignored once/shift for 1 Form Surge; immunity remains. No general physical resistance from cold terrain in this draft.

source.originalText:
Frost Wyrmling
Breath Weapon: As an action, you can exhale a 30-foot cone of freezing air. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 4d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Once you use this breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.
Scales of Ice: You gain a +2 bonus to AC
Cold Immunity: You are immune to cold damage

card.name: Master of Winter
card.effect: Cold immunity. Bounded winter weather invocation: create ordinary snow/sleet, difficult ground and sight limited 60 ft; no immediate damage or building collapse. This replaces undefined free high-rank control weather until an operational catalog version is selected; no RP, still 1 D.

source.originalText:
Master of Winter
At 14th level, you gain immunity to cold damage. Additionally, you can cast the control weather spell once without expending Resonance Points, but when you do so, you can only create weather conditions related to winter (such as snow, sleet, or freezing rain). Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

card.name: Vermin Affinity
card.rangeAndTarget: Rotshaper Circle; Tiny natural beasts within 10 ft
card.effect: Communicate simple feelings/directions; normally indifferent, not compelled allies. Cannot extract facts beyond their senses or control swarms for extra actions.

source.originalText:
Vermin Affinity
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you can communicate simple ideas with tiny beasts such as rats, spiders, insects, and other vermin. Additionally, such creatures are indifferent to you by default rather than hostile.

card.name: Swarm Summoning
card.effect: Summon one swarm using shared companion profile: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP 2 L, Speed 30, melee attack PB+WIS for S d6 piercing. Bonus Action command, one damaging action across all pets. Tiny-body movement through 1 inchgaps; no separate attacks per insect.

source.originalText:
Swarm Summoning
Starting at 2nd level, you can summon a swarm of tiny creatures to aid you. As an action, you can summon a swarm of insects, rats, or spiders (your choice) in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. The swarm acts on your initiative count and obeys your verbal commands. It lasts for 10 minutes, until it drops to 0 hit points, or until you dismiss it as a bonus action.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

card.name: Plague Bearer
card.rangeAndTarget: Rotshaper Circle; creature hit by your melee attack
card.effect: CON save or Poisoned and 1d6 poison at start turn. Repeat end turn; ends on success or after 3 turns. No lasting epidemic or loss of character control.

source.originalText:
Plague Bearer
Beginning at 6th level, you can infect creatures with debilitating diseases. When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature is poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature takes 1d6 poison damage at the start of each of its turns.
The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

card.name: Carrion Rat King
card.effect: Bite 1d8+WIS piercing+2d6 poison; CON save or Poisoned through end next turn. Immune disease/Poisoned, not poison damage. Summon Action creates one bounded engine swarm 1 minute, same command budget; replaces previous form swarm.

source.originalText:
Carrion Rat King
Poison Bite: Your bite attack deals 1d8 piercing damage plus 2d6 poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.
Summon Swarm: As an action, you can summon a swarm of rats that acts on your initiative and obeys your mental commands. The swarm lasts for 1 minute or until reduced to 0 hit points.
Disease Immunity: You are immune to disease and the poisoned condition.

card.name: Insect Broodmother
card.rangeAndTarget: Rotshaper Hero; up to 2 swarms adjacent
card.effect: AC normal+3, climb 30 walls/ceilings, bite 1d8+WIS piercing. On entry optional spend surge spawn 2 bounded shared profile swarms, both end with form, combined one commanded attack/turn. Once/shift for another Form Surge turn one crit against you into normal hit; no infinite insects.

source.originalText:
Insect Broodmother
Spawn Swarms: Each time you transform into this form, you can spawn 1d4 swarms of insects (CR 1/4 each) that act on your initiative and obey your mental commands. The swarms last until they are reduced to 0 hit points or until you revert to your normal form.
Chitinous Armor: You gain a +3 bonus to AC
Wall Crawling: You can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without making an ability check.

card.name: Master of Vermin
card.effect: Swarm form: own HP/AC, physical resistance, Speed 30, fit Tinygaps, natural attack S d6+WIS piercing. No flight unless choosing bats (flight 30), which forfeits physical resistance. Replacing a summoning spell's beast with swarm uses same single companion budget and paid spell, never multiplied dice/creatures.

source.originalText:
Master of Vermin
At 14th level, you gain the ability to transform into a swarm of tiny beasts (insects, rats, bats, or spiders) as if using your Shapeshifting feature. While in swarm form, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and you can move through any space large enough for a Tiny creature without squeezing.
Additionally, when you cast a spell that summons or creates beasts, you can choose to summon a swarm instead of individual creatures.

card.name: Fire Affinity
card.effect: Resistance fire and additional produce flame cantrip. No immunity to smoke/suffocation or supernatural heat beyond resistance.

source.originalText:
Fire Affinity
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain resistance to fire damage. Additionally, you learn the produce flame cantrip if you don't already know it.

card.name: Blazing Rebirth
card.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Grove; ally/self 30 ft taking fire damage
card.effect: Grant L+M temporary HP after real hostile/environmental fire damage. Cannot reduce triggering hit retroactively or trigger from deliberate ally/self-farming. Normal temporary HP nonstacking; no buffer reserve payment because finite feature use.

source.originalText:
Blazing Rebirth
Starting at 2nd level, you can channel the regenerative power of fire. When you or an ally within 30 feet of you takes fire damage, you can use your reaction to grant temporary hit points equal to your druid level + your Wisdom modifier to that creature.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

card.name: Flame Stride
card.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Grove; up to 6 ground tiles traversed
card.effect: For 3 rounds immune to nonmagical environmental fire only. Leave up to 6 total 5 ft fire tiles along movement; creatures entering/starting DEX save or 1d6 fire, once/creature/round across all tiles. Tiles end with feature; no recursive area expansion.

source.originalText:
Flame Stride
Beginning at 6th level, you can move through fire without taking damage. Additionally, when you move through a space containing fire, you can choose to leave a trail of fire behind you. Each creature that enters this fire for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 1d6 fire damage.
The fire lasts for 1 minute or until extinguished. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

card.name: Charbear
card.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Hero; claw 5 ft/aura 5 ft/smoke 10 ft
card.effect: Claw 2d8+WIS fire; first hit/turn Burn 1d4 next turn. Up to 3 enemies starting 5 ft CON save or 1d6 fire. Smoke Action opaque 10 ft radius sphere centered fixed point you occupy, concentration 3 rounds; all vision blocked, no poison in this draft. Wind 20 mph disperses.

source.originalText:
Charbear
Flame Aura: Creatures within 5 ft. of you take 1d6 fire damage at the start of their turn
Fire Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d8 fire damage
Smoke Cloud: As an action, you can create a 20-foot-radius sphere of smoke centered on yourself. The area is heavily obscured, and creatures other than you that start their turn in the smoke must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of their next turn.

card.name: Blazewood Stag
card.cost: One shift; blast one long-rest use
card.effect: Antlers 1d8+WIS piercing; 20 ft charge adds 2d6 fire once/turn. Leave up to 3 fire tiles/turn, last until start next turn, DEX save or 1d8 fire once/creature/round. Blast Action 6d6 fire DEX half up to 3 creatures 10 ft, not free on reversion.

source.originalText:
Blazewood Stag
Flaming Trail: You leave a trail of fire behind you as you move. Each creature that enters this fire for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 1d8 fire damage.
Burning Charge: If you move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit with a horn attack, the target takes an additional 2d6 fire damage.
Conflagration: Once per long rest, you can explode in a burst of flame. Each creature within 10 ft. of you must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 6d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

card.name: Master of Ash
card.cost: Plant growth normal cost and 10 minutes
card.effect: Immune fire. Before one initial save against your fire spell impose-2, never auto failure. A paid prepared plant growth may restore ordinary vegetation in burned land within its printed area; no instant food/valuable timber, magical plants or creature creation.

source.originalText:
Master of Ash
At 14th level, you gain immunity to fire damage. Additionally, when you cast a spell that deals fire damage, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one) to automatically fail their saving throws against the spell.
Furthermore, you can cast the plant growth spell to instantly restore vegetation to an area devastated by fire, causing plants to grow to full maturity within minutes rather than over the course of a year.

card.name: Resonance Shield
card.cost: Spend X RP, where X is 1, 2 or 3
card.duration: 1 minute or until temporary HP are lost
card.effect: Resonance Shield. Tags: mage-spell, abjuration, protection. Spend 1-3 RP and gain temporary HP equal to X × (S + M). Temporary HP do not stack. This spell is non-elemental and therefore clears an active Elemental Nuke Chain. Its RP payment cannot be reduced below 1 by Spell Efficiency.

source.originalText: Resonance Shield: Convert a portion of your Resonance Points into a temporary protective barrier.

card.name: Empowered Link
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to M allies within 25 feet
card.duration: Matches the shared benefit, maximum until end of your next regular turn
card.effect: Empowered Link. Tags: archmage, buff. When one of your Mage cards grants you temporary HP, a Speed bonus or a numeric attack/save bonus, choose up to M allies within 25 feet. They gain the same non-resource benefit at half its numeric amount rounded down, minimum 1 where applicable. It never shares Actions, RP, Focus, concentration, invisibility, summons or class resources. Resistance is not a numeric bonus and is not shared by this card.

source.originalText: Empowered Link: Share buffs with allies in a 5-tile radius.

card.name: Harmonized Core
card.duration: Temporary HP until lost or replaced
card.effect: Harmonized Core. Tags: archmage, support. After one of your damaging Mage spells deals damage, choose one ally within 30 feet. It gains temporary HP equal to 10% of one target's unmodified rolled damage dice total from that spell, rounded down, minimum 1 and maximum S+M. This is not HP healing and cannot trigger healing features or Echo-style repetitions.

source.originalText: Harmonized Core: Spells heal allies for 10% of base damage as temporary HP.

card.name: Arcane Sanctuary
card.effect: Arcane Sanctuary. Tags: mage-spell, archmage, zone, concentration. On start and each paid Bonus Action maintenance pulse, allies in the zone gain S+M temporary HP until the start of your next regular turn or effect end, whichever is first and +1 to Mage or spell attack rolls while inside. The zone grants no save-DC increase and no additional Actions. Maximum 3 pulses.

source.originalText: Arcane Sanctuary: Create a zone of protection that shields allies and enhances their magical abilities.

card.name: Lingering Malice
card.effect: Lingering Malice. Tags: mage-spell, lich, necrotic, zone, concentration. Choose Fear or Drain when cast. On start and each paid Bonus Action maintenance pulse, enemies in the zone make Wisdom saves. Failure takes S d6 necrotic. Fear mode also Frightens until the start of your next turn. Drain mode lets you gain temporary HP equal to M once per pulse if at least one enemy fails. Maximum 3 pulses; each pulse grants a new save.

source.originalText: Lingering Malice: Create a necrotic zone for 3 rounds that applies Fear or Drain effects.

card.name: Soulbound Ritual
card.rangeAndTarget: One of your destroyed bound elite undead companions within 30 feet or its inert binding token
card.effect: Soulbound Ritual. Tags: mage-spell, lich, companion, resurrection. Return one destroyed Boneflayer, Dreadblade or Wraithbound to an unoccupied space within 30 feet at half its maximum HP. It gains S+M temporary HP for 1 minute. The returned companion remains subject to the shared Companion Command limit and cannot create a corpse, XP, loot or resource event if destroyed again.

source.originalText: Soulbound Ritual: Revive a fallen undead pet with bonus stats.

classRecords.text: Record source creature/name, witnessed ability, category, damage type, allowed rank, capture encounter and whether first release has occurred. For this pilot, capture copies the observed role into ONE bounded profile: Strike=one target 60 ft class spell attack S d8 observed damage type; Burst=up to 3 enemies in 10 ft radius within 30 ft DEX save S d6, half on success; Mend=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Ward=one ally 30 ft S d6+M temporary HP for 1 minute; Hindrance=one enemy 30 ft WIS save or Speed-10 ft and no Reactions until end its next turn. Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

card.name: Radiant Archive
card.cost: RP for 3 support Echoes; consume all 3; 1 long-rest use
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 legal allies within 30 ft
card.effect: Release three stored Mend/Ward records as ONE package; assign each to one ally. No ally receives more than two components and temporary HP never stack. All costs paid; no extra release or resurrection. Missing records cannot be invented.

source.originalText: Final – Radiant Archive: Cast 3 stored divine Echoes at once (once/day).

card.name: Blessing Echo
card.cost: Recorded RP cost+1; consume offensive Echo
card.effect: Convert a stored Strike/Burst record to Mend/Ward for this release, chosen on activation; heal S d6+M or grant same temporary HP. This explicit conversion cannot also deal offensive damage or copy a condition.

source.originalText: Blessing Echo: Transform a captured offensive Echo into a beneficial effect that can heal or protect allies.

card.name: Light Binding
card.effect: Choose mode: enemies make STR save or Restrained; they repeat save at turn end. OR up to 2 allies gain S d6+M temporary HP. No mixed modes; bonds are magical and not permanent objects.

source.originalText: Light Binding: Create bonds of radiant energy that can restrain enemies or create protective barriers for allies.

card.name: Discipline Initiate
card.effect: Discipline Initiate. Tags: base, discipline. Choose Offense, Tank or Support. Offense technique: once per turn in Tiger after an unarmed hit, spend 1 Ki to deal +S damage and push the target 5 feet if it is no more than one size larger. Tank: unlock the Tortoise Discipline Arch cards under the common gate. Support technique: once per turn in Crane after an unarmed hit, spend 1 Ki to grant one ally within 15 feet S+M temporary HP. The chosen discipline cannot be changed without a future retraining rule.

source.originalText: Discipline Initiate: Choose a discipline (offense, tank, support) and gain 1 technique based on it.

classRecords.text: Healing from Oracle features cannot exceed maximum HP, resurrect the dead or remove Wounds unless a feature explicitly says so. Temporary HP never stack. Encounter-only regeneration and drain cannot be farmed outside meaningful combat. Corpse effects create no XP, loot, RC or repeatable corpse resources unless expressly stated.

card.name: Spiral-Touched — Boon V
card.effect: 1/long rest as a Reaction before the fourth round of the encounter begins, rewind the current encounter to its initiative-start snapshot: restore combatant positions, HP, temporary HP, conditions, RC and per-encounter uses to that snapshot. Short-/long-rest uses, physical consumables and this Time Loop use remain spent. Slain encounter participants return to their snapshot state and no duplicate XP, treasure or consumables are created. Allies retain memory of the previous timeline. Time Loop does not restore RP, Ki, Conviction, Blood Gauge, device stock, healing reserves or any other daily/rest resource; only the named RC and per-encounter states rewind. No loot changes ownership through rewinding. Record the snapshot at initiative; if no complete snapshot exists, this option is unavailable and unspent. It cannot undo a previous encounter or duplicate a per-rest use.

value.name: Spiral-Touched
limitations: You sometimes respond to events before they happen, causing confusion in social situations
You occasionally experience time differently than others, potentially missing turns in combat (5% chance)
You cannot maintain concentration on mundane tasks for extended periods

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: See 1 round into the future during initiative (+3 initiative). Once per day, reroll a failed save as you briefly step outside the timestream.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to act out of turn once per combat. You gain resistance to time-based magic and aging effects.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you may instead phase out of time for 1 round, becoming untargetable and regaining 25% of your maximum HP. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: You exist in multiple timestreams simultaneously, allowing you to make two different actions in a single turn once per combat. Enemies attacking you have a 10% chance to hit your echo instead, causing the attack to miss.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: You gain the ability to create a time loop, resetting an entire combat encounter to its beginning state once per day. All allies retain knowledge of the original timeline, allowing them to make different choices.

value.source: rulebook — Example Curse: Spiral-Touched (only full curse tree in player rulebook)

card.name: Flame Revelation Mastery
card.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
card.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Wrathful Brand: its maximum duration becomes 2 rounds. Enhanced Crown's Burn: its healing may target up to three living allies within 4 tiles of the burst center rather than requiring them inside the burst. Enhanced First Flame Convergence: Zealot's Renewal backlash remains suppressed for the full Convergence duration; if already suppressed by the base effect, additionally one ally healed by Zealot's Renewal during Convergence gains S temporary HP.

value: Enhanced Wrathful Brand: mark lasts 2 rounds
Enhanced Crown's Burn: allies need not be in burst to receive healing
Enhanced First Flame Convergence: no backlash on Zealot's Renewal during effect

card.name: Overflowing Light
card.effect: The target regains 2d6+M HP. Healing exceeding its maximum becomes temporary HP, maximum 10, lasting 2 rounds. When those temporary HP expire naturally, if at least 1 remains the target may end one of Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered. This cannot resurrect, remove Wounds or convert deliberately wasted healing into more than 10 temporary HP.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Overflowing Light
value.description: Spend 1 charge: heal one ally within 4 tiles for 2d6 + your Charisma modifier; excess healing above max HP becomes temporary HP (max 10) for 2 rounds, and if any temp HP remains when it fades the ally ends one minor condition.

card.name: Life Revelation Mastery
card.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
card.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Overflowing Light: maximum temporary HP from excess healing becomes 20. Enhanced Garden of Restoration: the first Garden pulse a creature receives may end both Poisoned and one disease that explicitly allows magical curing, rather than only one of those benefits. Enhanced Song of Mending: duration becomes 3 rounds and gains one additional 2d6 healing pulse at the start of your second later regular turn; each ally still receives only one 1-HP death prevention per use.

value: Enhanced Overflowing Light: temp HP max 20
Enhanced Garden of Restoration: also removes poison/disease on entry
Enhanced Song of Mending: duration 3 turns

classRecords.text: At 17 Aura Surge once/short rest Bonus Action: until start next turn choose up to 3 allies in aura to gain S+M temporary HP and+1 saves. This bounded surge replaces vague doubling of every aura number. At 20 Divine Manifestation makes the aura active upon initiative without an action, radius 30 ft; it ignores ordinary Silence and terrain obstruction between allies but not antimagic explicitly suppressing divine powers, planar barriers or the consciousness rule. Source cannot-be-suppressed language is bounded explicitly. It grants no free Signature, Smite or Revelation spell.

card.name: Bolstering Presence
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies 15 ft who can perceive you
card.effect: Each gains+2 on its next save against Charmed or Frightened and M temporary HP. Use strongest save bonus from same class; does not end existing conditions automatically.

source.originalText: Bolstering Presence: Inspire nearby allies, granting them temporary bonuses to saves against fear and charm effects.

card.name: Dread Shelter
card.effect: New rank 2 Forbidden spell. Gain 2 S+M temporary HP on casting and 1 flat DR against weapon damage for duration. No recurring temp HP pulse or healing.

card.name: Black Manifestation
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 enemies in aura
card.effect: New Oathbreaker Final: gain 2 S+M temporary HP; chosen enemies WIS save or lose Reactions and Speed-10 ft for duration. Refresh one expended Signature use, then pay its normal Action and other costs when used. No Death Touch pool, RP, extra Action or Final reset.

card.name: Channel Life
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and one living ally within 30 feet
card.effect: Choose X from 1 to Paladin level+M, limited so your current HP remains at least 1. Lose X HP; this loss cannot be reduced, redirected or prevented. The target regains X HP. This is a direct transfer, cannot exceed the target's maximum HP and cannot remove Wounds or create excess temporary HP.

value.spell: Channel Life — transfer HP from self to ally

card.name: Healing Suppression
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
card.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
card.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn

classRecords.text: Chosen Hero grants a sixth Arrow at 11. Warder Nature's Wrath: ranged attack weapon+S d6 piercing; up to 2 allies within 10 ft gain M temporary HP (finite mitigation, not repeatable real healing). Stalker Phantom: two ranged attacks against different aligned targets within 60 ft, each weapon damage, no extra dice; one Arrow activation. Outrider Corruption: place 10 ft-radius zone within 60 ft, concentration until start next turn; up to 3 enemies entering/starting there take S d4 necrotic once each, CON half. Arrow copies cannot generate extra attacks, resources or permanent terrain changes.

card.name: Nature's Blessing
card.effect: Ally gains+10 ft Speed and S d6+M temporary HP on start. While effect lasts it has advantage on saves against forced movement. Temporary HP are not refreshed each turn.

source.originalText: Nature's Blessing: Grant an ally temporary bonuses to speed and resilience.

card.name: Master of the Hunt — new Hero capstone
card.effect: New playtest Hero capstone. Once per long rest when using your Hero Arrow, pay its normal Hit Chain/action requirements, then enhance only that activation: Warder grants 2 M temporary HP instead of M; Stalker adds S d6 piercing to one of its two hits; Outrider adds S d4 necrotic to one target on its single pulse. No extra Arrow, Hit Chain, action or copied proc.

card.name: Totem Pulse
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures inside newly placed non-healing totem
card.effect: On placement pay 1 RP: allies gain M temporary HP OR enemies make DEX save for S affinity damage, half on success. No immediate second Renewal healing pulse, no repeat from moving the totem.

source.originalText: Totem Pulse: Totems create an immediate area effect when placed (level 6).

card.name: Blight Totem
card.rangeAndTarget: Totem within 30 ft; 15 ft aura affecting all creatures
card.effect: HP healing received inside aura is halved, rounding down, including allies and you. Nonstacking with another healing reduction; temporary HP unaffected. This totem has standard object stats and grants no free damage/healing.

source.originalText: Blight Totem: Place a corrupted totem that reduces all healing in its area by 50%.

card.name: Rally Point
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies within 15 ft who hear you
card.effect: Each gains M temporary HP and+1 on the next saving throw before duration ends. Temporary HP follows strongest-only rule and is lost at encounter end.

source.originalText: Rally Point: Designate a location that grants allies who move there a small defensive bonus.

card.name: Rallying Cry
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies within 30 ft who hear you
card.duration: Instant; temp HP to encounter end
card.effect: End Frightened on each and grant S+M temporary HP. Cannot revive, heal real HP or repeatedly refresh from imitation/copies.

source.originalText: Rallying Cry: Remove fear effects from nearby allies and grant temporary hit points.

card.name: Final Command
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 willing allies within 30 ft who hear you
card.effect: New Hero capstone. Allies may each move 10 ft without opportunity attacks and gain S+M temporary HP. You refresh one expended short-rest Soldier card, excluding Final Command and long-rest features. A refreshed card still costs its activation and ammunition; no extra turn or recursive resets.

card.name: Protective Programming
card.rangeAndTarget: Drone adjacent to ally hit by attack
card.effect: Drone grants ally S+M temporary HP before hit resolves. No heal or reversal of hit; max one protected ally, normal temporary HP nonstacking.

source.originalText: Protective Programming: Your drone prioritizes defending vulnerable allies.

card.name: Nano-Aegis Drone

source.originalText: Nano-Aegis Drone: Replace your combat drone with a healing/shield drone that protects allies.

card.name: Mutation Surge

card.effect: Mutation Surge. Enhance one active mutation. source.originalText: Mutation Surge: Temporarily enhance an active mutation, increasing its effects for 1 round but adding strain to your body.

card.name: Aegis Incarnate

Whenever an ally within 15 feet takes damage, automatically redirect half that damage rounded down to yourself after the ally's resistance but before its temporary HP; the ally takes the remainder. Redirected damage keeps its type, cannot be reduced again or generate BT, and cannot be redirected again. If taking the redirected damage would kill you outright, the redirection still occurs. This grants no extra Reaction requirement and does not stack with Guardian Tissue on the same damage event.

source.originalText: Final Form – Aegis Incarnate: Transform into a living shield for 3 rounds, becoming immovable and redirecting 50% of all damage dealt to allies within 15 feet to yourself.

card.name: Bone Hardened
card.effect: While you are not Staggered, reduce physical weapon damage you take by 1 after resistance and before temporary HP.

source.originalText: | 6 | Bone Hardened: DR +1 while not staggered |

classRecords.text: ABJURATION, provisional completion for the omitted eighth row: once per round after you cast an Abjuration spell, gain temporary HP equal to PB until the start of your next regular turn. CONJURATION: creatures summoned by your Wizard spells gain +1 maximum HP per Wizard level. DIVINATION: once per long rest reroll one failed saving throw and use the new result. ENCHANTMENT: when a creature fails its initial save against one of your Enchantment spells, a printed control duration of at least 1 round may last one additional round, but every normally allowed repeat save still occurs. EVOCATION: when casting an area Evocation spell, exclude one creature from its initial damaging area; that creature automatically succeeds and takes no damage if success normally halves damage. ILLUSION: gain +2 on concentration saves made to maintain Illusion spells. NECROMANCY: once per turn during a real encounter when a hostile non-summoned creature dies from your Necromancy spell, gain 1 temporary HP; it is not permanent healing. TRANSMUTATION: after casting a Transmutation spell, gain +5 feet Speed until the end of that turn.

card.name: Knowledge Shield
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per ally per round
card.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

card.name: Spell Absorption
card.rangeAndTarget: One hostile spell that directly targets you
card.effect: Spell Absorption. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, abjuration. Trigger after you become the target of a hostile spell but before it resolves. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell rank. On success that spell has no effect on you, though it resolves normally against other targets, and you gain temporary HP equal to spell rank + M. On failure it resolves normally and the use is spent.

source.originalText: Spell Absorption: Absorb a hostile spell, gaining temporary hit points equal to the spell's level.

card.name: Arcane Leech
card.effect: Arcane Leech. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive. When at least one hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of your Wizard spells, gain temporary HP equal to S+M. Multiple failed targets from the same spell do not multiply the amount. This does not drain actual HP, generate RP or trigger from your companions' abilities.

source.originalText: Arcane Leech: Gain temporary hit points when a creature fails a save against your spells.
